==Notes==
* Using with [[Vital Boon]] or [[Faithful Intervention]] can provide a large healing boost.
* Can be combined with [[Pious Renewal]] to create quickly recharging skill chain for healing and managing [[energy]].
{{anomaly|As long as the user is under the effects of a Dervish enchantment when attempting to activate this skill, Signet of Pious Light will recharge in 5 seconds, regardless of other effects.}}
